items.title: Percy Heath — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Yeah, and Specs Wright from Philly. He went through all these drummers, man it was unbelievable.

ctx.x: Yeah, and Specs Wright from Philly. He went through all these drummers, man it was unbelievable. Every two weeks it was a different drummer. And J.C. Heard’s brother, David, Kansas Fields. I’m talking about five different drummers while I was there a year and a half. But Jackson was there, Milt was there with me. And then when Percy was born, and June brought Percy to Chicago ‘cause I came home from Chicago, we used to come home, it was like $25 airfare at that time round trip, and I had two days off in Chicago,…
